data/vision_diagnosis_20261005/execute10.note: Single paired run per fixed seed; height >3 cm is a lift proxy, not proof of secure grasp. Official success includes relative block geometry and both grippers open. Step indices here are zero-based.

data/vision_diagnosis_20261005/expert_vi.method: HSV connected components on raw 320x240 RGB. This tests image visibility, not whether ACT detects the object. Occlusion can split components. Threshold is an audit heuristic.

notes: Closure events are downward crossings of commanded opening 0.5, not confirmed contact events. Target color by phase is heuristic (red before step 170). TCP is robot-defined gripper center in world coordinates.
